mapper.select: /* login-log-mapper.getLoginLogDetailsDateInfo (선택된 로그인 로그 날짜 범위 조회) */ WITH temp_op_login_log AS ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.login_log_id, A.login_type, A.login_id, A.success_flag, A.remote_addr, A.memo, A.login_date FROM ( SELECT LL.login_log_id, LL.login_type, LL.login_id, LL.success_flag, LL.remote_addr, LL.memo, LL.login_date FROM op_login_log LL WHERE LL.login_id = (SELECT login_id FROM op_login_log WHERE login_log_id = #{loginLogId}) ORDER BY LL.login_date DESC ) A ) SELECT B.login_id AS login_id, B.remote_addr AS remote_addr, B.login_type, B.authority, B.role_name, B.login_date, B.next_login_date FROM ( SELECT A.login_id, A.remote_addr, A.login_type, R.authority, R.role_name, IFNULL(A.login_date, '') AS login_date, IFNULL((SELECT login_date FROM temp_op_login_log WHERE rnum < A.rnum ORDER BY rnum DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS next_login_date FROM temp_op_login_log A LEFT OUTER JOIN op_manager M ON M.login_id = A.login_id AND A.login_type = 'manager' LEFT OUTER JOIN op_user_role UR ON UR.user_id = M.user_id AND UR.authority LIKE 'ROLE_ADMIN_%' LEFT OUTER JOIN op_role R ON R.authority = UR.authority WHERE A.login_log_id = #{loginLogId} LIMIT 1 ) B
/* login-log-mapper.getUserLoginLogListCountByParam (사용자 로그인 로그 목록 갯수 조회) */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_USER_LOGIN_LOG LL

/* login-log-mapper.getUserLoginLogDetailsDateInfo (선택된 사용자 로그인 로그 날짜 범위 조회) */ WITH TEMP_OP_LOGIN_LOG AS ( SELECT ROWNUM AS rnum, A.login_log_id, A.login_type, A.login_id, A.success_flag, A.remote_addr, A.memo, A.login_date FROM ( SELECT LL.login_log_id, LL.login_type, LL.login_id, LL.success_flag, LL.remote_addr, LL.memo, LL.login_date FROM op_user_login_log LL WHERE LL.login_id = (SELECT login_id FROM op_user_login_log WHERE login_log_id = #{loginLogId}) ORDER BY LL.login_date DESC ) A ) SELECT B.login_id AS login_id, B.remote_addr AS remote_addr, B.login_type, B.login_date, B.next_login_date FROM ( SELECT A.login_id, A.remote_addr, A.login_type, IFNULL(A.login_date, '') AS login_date, IFNULL((SELECT login_date FROM temp_op_login_log WHERE rnum < A.rnum ORDER BY rnum DESC LIMIT 1), '') AS next_login_date FROM temp_op_login_log A WHERE A.login_log_id = #{loginLogId} LIMIT 1 ) B
